description: Defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes for applying patches in a version control system, including apply state management, patch representation, and diff parsing.

methods.name: apply_parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for applying patches and updates the apply_state accordingly.

methods.name: init_apply_state
methods.description: Initializes the apply_state structure with repository info and prefix.

methods.name: clear_apply_state
methods.description: Resets or frees resources associated with apply_state.

methods.name: check_apply_state
methods.description: Validates the current apply_state, optionally forcing reinitialization.

methods.name: parse_git_diff_header
methods.description: Parses a diff header line to extract patch metadata.

methods.name: release_patch
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a patch object.

methods.name: apply_all_patches
methods.description: Applies a series of patches based on the current apply_state and options.
